identifierKeying.principle: Key on the authority's own stable series identifier, never on a display name. Applied, and it found two more instances of the same defect class as the COT LIKE and the issuer-graph fuzzy name match.

eia.method: exact facet on every request; the returned row's `series` field is re-asserted against the requested identifier on every fetch, so a re-pointed identifier fails instead of returning a different number under the same label
eia.source_of_truth: app/data/futures_catalog.json eia_series registry; app/providers/eia.py holds no series table of its own, which is what retires the carried-from-code condition rather than restating it

treasury_auctions.method: :eq: exact match only; no :like:, :contains: or :in: path exists in treasury.py and a test enforces that. Discriminators are asserted on the response as well as sent on the request.
treasury_auctions.why_original_security_term: security_term is the term REMAINING at that auction (a 30-Year reopening carries '29-Year 10-Month'), so keying on it silently drops every reopening. original_security_term is the program and is stable.

treasury_outstanding.method: :eq: exact match on a closed controlled vocabulary — 'Notes' is a prefix of 'Floating Rate Notes'
treasury_outstanding.rejected_key: src_line_nbr — it looks like a code but is the line's POSITION in the printed statement, so it moves if Treasury reorders the table. A positional identifier fails the same way a name does.

carriedForward.verificationResult: FAILED VERIFICATION. It was not an identifier at all.
carriedForward.whatItActuallyReturned: NW2_EPG0_SNO_R33_BCF — 'Weekly Nonsalt Region Natural Gas Working Underground Storage'. The unfaceted route returns all 8 series it publishes, newest first, and the read took whichever sorted first.
carriedForward.magnitude: 807 BCF served as the US national figure on 2026-08-07, where the Lower 48 total is 3,153 BCF. A 3.9x error on the /NG contract's own inventory driver.
carriedForward.symptom: It never errored. It returned a plausible neighbour, order-dependently — verbatim the symptom the rule names.
carriedForward.resolution: Re-keyed to NW2_EPG0_SWO_R48_BCF and verified live. The catalog row carries a `supersedes` field naming what it replaced, so the correction is not silent.

recordedAbsences.scope: EIA v2 route tree under natural-gas enumerated 2026-08-17: sum, pri, enr, prod, move, stor, cons. The only weekly route is stor/wkly. natural-gas/prod/sum publishes monthly and annual only, endPeriod 2026-05.
recordedAbsences.consequence: /NG carries storage and no production series, rather than a monthly number sitting beside weekly ones as if it shared their cadence.

recordedAbsences.scope: The committed CME FPRF snapshot's Instrmt attributes (Sym, Desc, SecTyp, CFI, Exch, Mult, UOM, UOMQty, PxUOM, PxUOMQty, SettlMeth, MinPxIncr, PxQteCcy, ProdCmplx) plus TickRules. No deliverable-grade or remaining-maturity-window field is published.
recordedAbsences.consequence: The Treasury layer resolves at program-level and says so. The catalog does not name which CUSIPs are deliverable into which contract, because no authority wired into this repo publishes that.

recordedAbsences.scope: mspd_table_1 record fields on 2026-08-17. The class vocabulary is Bills, Notes, Bonds, Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities, Floating Rate Notes, Federal Financing Bank. There is no original-term dimension.
recordedAbsences.consequence: /ZN and /ZT share the Notes balance, marked shared_with rather than relabelled per root, which would imply two measurements exist. Per-CUSIP detail in mspd_table_3_market could be aggregated by original term, but that is a build, not a published series, and is not claimed.
